lens: evidence integrity, privacy, identity, and action authority

findings.criterion: Deployed temporal ambiguity and action authority
findings.observation: The final local build keeps the seeded Wednesday and Tuesday-afternoon statements unresolved and creates no time action. The live public Demo still shows four confirmable items, zero clarification items, and a meeting proposal from unresolved Tuesday afternoon.
findings.evidence: output/playwright/2026-08-11-ui99-production-demo-002.png; Playwright session ts-99-live-002; candidate behavior is covered by the passing DEMO-06 and DEMO-07 atoms in docs/evaluations/2026-08-11-system-ui-click-acceptance-002.json.
findings.user_impact: The deployed evaluation surface teaches users that ambiguous relative time can safely become relationship state or scheduling authority.
findings.recommendation: Keep the paid gate blocked until the guarded build is deployed and an automated production probe asserts the exact ambiguity outcome.
findings.verification: The live seeded note produces two supported proposals, two clarification items, and no deadline or meeting proposal.

findings.observation: The fresh local evaluator proves tenant isolation, permission-at-use, idempotency, timeout reconciliation, safe revision/retry, supersession, and deletion with zero direct external writes. The final UI also separates current state from history and preserves unknown observations. Speaker uncertainty, forwarded-source authority, unresolved identity persistence, correction history, action reversal, and a real provider lifecycle remain unrun.
findings.evidence: output/evaluations/2026-08-11-ui99/backend-built-r6/evaluation-progress.json; the 14 not_run atoms and known gaps in the acceptance-002 artifact.
findings.user_impact: Local governed state is materially safer, but the system is not yet justified for sensitive real candidate evidence or real external writes.
findings.recommendation: Run the remaining identity cases and one separately authorized provider sandbox effect including reversal, retention, deletion, and incident-path checks.
findings.verification: Unresolved or forwarded evidence grants no identity authority, corrections remain versioned, and the provider effect is at-most-once, observable, reversible where promised, and deletable under the stated lifecycle.

strengths: Wiki and person briefs now exclude source receipts and superseded facts from current truth.
Fact confirmation and action approval remain independent, with exact target and effect visible before approval.
Unknown external results remain unknown through reload and require reconciliation before retry.
Source deletion retracts governed derivatives while preserving deletion lineage.
missing_evidence: Production parity for temporal ambiguity and usable authenticated access.
Speaker, forwarded-source, unresolved-identity, temporal-handle, and identity-correction cases on the final UI.
A real provider sandbox lifecycle including audit and reversal.
vetoes: The deployed public Demo still converts unresolved relative time into confirmable deadline and meeting authority.
open_questions: Which release probe will fail deployment automatically when the public Demo regresses from clarification to action?
